summary: Incomplete --max-pages syncs and per-page resume checkpoints must not advance last_synced_at; only a completed page loop (cleared cursor) is a snapshot observation.
reason: movers and designers-deltas key design_snapshots on GetLastSyncedAt. Stamping last_synced_at when a resume cursor is preserved makes the next resumed pages look like new upstream activity (designers deltas NewDesigns) even when MakerWorld data has not changed. --latest-only still stamps because it clears the cursor and treats the head page as a complete observation.
validated_outcome: SaveSyncCheckpoint preserves last_synced_at after SaveSyncState and leaves it empty on first insert; go test ./internal/store ./internal/cli pass.
